name: Breaking A Vow
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that making a vow to the Lord is a solemn commitment that must not be broken or deferred. Numbers 30:2 emphasizes that when a person vows or swears an oath, they are bound to fulfill their word, and Deuteronomy 23:21 warns that failing to pay a vow is considered sin. Leviticus 5:4 further explains that ignorance of a vow does not excuse guilt once one becomes aware of it. Ecclesiastes 5:4 reinforces that God takes vows seriously and finds no pleasure in those who delay fulfilling them, underscoring the importance of faithfulness and integrity in our commitments to Him.
